title: Pokemon TCG Scovillian ex Surging Sparks 216/191 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card from the Surging Sparks set, featuring the Scovillian ex Double Rare Holo card number 216/191. This collectible card game item is in English and belongs to the EX speciality category. The card is highly sought after by collectors for its rarity and unique design, making it a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection.
